verdict.rationale: Clerk publishes a public GitHub repository for its JavaScript SDKs (clerk/javascript) and describes its user-migration tool as open source, so some client-side source is readable. The core hosted auth service is not shown to be open source, no license is named, and community comments say the libraries are obfuscated and contrast Clerk with open-source alternatives. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated open license, availability of the core backend/service source, and independent confirmation that the published SDK source is readable rather than obfuscated.
